scope: NVIDIA product expansion: NIC/SuperNIC and LinkX interconnect
recommendation: Add a dedicated NIC/SuperNIC layer instead of hiding ConnectX under generic System/Networking.
Add a dedicated Interconnect/Cable layer for LinkX DAC/LACC/AOC/transceivers, QSA adapters, and breakout splitters.
Keep Spectrum-X/Quantum-X Photonics in System/Networking and cross-link NVIDIA into Optical Module.
